What is the primary purpose of creating a horizontal prototype in prototype development?
options: To develop a detailed, back-end integrated version of one application feature.
To explore and iterate on the surface-level design aspects across various user flow scenarios.
To focus exclusively on the technological feasibility of the product.
To test the final product in real-world conditions.
questions.correct_answer: To explore and iterate on the surface-level design aspects across various user flow scenarios.

questions.text: Which of the following onboarding design processes best describes the definition: “A series of steps a user goes through gradually to learn your product with a hands-on approach and interactive elements.”
When defining a conflict or contradiction in problem-solving, what is the primary objective of the ENV model?
options: To amplify the conflict to make it more dramatic and noticeable.
To provide a structured framework for analyzing the core elements of the conflict.
To eliminate all variables, reducing the conflict to a single element which is the desired result.
To focus solely on the emotional aspects of the conflict and not logical analysis.
questions.correct_answer: To provide a structured framework for analyzing the core elements of the conflict.

questions.text: State whether the following statement is true or false “Serendipity in innovation is the discovery of something intentional and planned, often with a beneficial outcome.”

When people encounter a device, they face two gulfs: A, where they try to figure out how to use it, and B, where they try to figure out what state it is in and whether their actions got them to their goal. [IMAGE: /data/images/ms4002_2024T3_ET_FN_p7_Im1.webp|block] What are A and B?
options: A - Gulf of Execution, B - Gulf of Empathy
A - Gulf of Evaluation, B - Gulf of Execution
A - Gulf of Execution, B - Gulf of Evaluation
A - Gulf of Empathy, B - Gulf of Execution
questions.correct_answer: A - Gulf of Execution, B - Gulf of Evaluation

questions.text: When revisiting the customer journey map in the Test phase, what aspect is crucial to assess for the app's subsequent prototype?
options: Ensuring the journey map remains unchanged from the first prototype.
Evaluating how the modifications in the prototype impact the overall user journey and experience.
Focusing only on the technical performance indicators in the journey map.
Completely redesigning the journey map to fit the new prototype.
questions.correct_answer: Evaluating how the modifications in the prototype impact the overall user journey and experience.

How should the Multi-Why analysis be applied in the third iteration of the Karmic Design Thinking process to deepen our understanding of user behaviour?
options: Reaffirming the effectiveness of previously implemented solutions without further investigation.
Reducing the complexity of the inquiry by limiting the depth and breadth of questions.
Exclusively analyzing feedback from newly engaged users, neglecting insights from prior iterations.
Probing further into unresolved user issues by critically examining underlying assumptions.
questions.correct_answer: Probing further into unresolved user issues by critically examining underlying assumptions.

In the Karmic Design Thinking process, how do we determine the list of features to test for the eventual solution? 1. Write opposing features of the desired result from the conflict of interest analysis. 2. Extract features from solutions in the Solve phase. Which of the above statements is/are correct?

According to Don Norman, what is the most important principle for managing complexity?
options: Complexity should be avoided at all costs, and the focus should be on simplicity and ease of use, from the perspective of the user.
Complexity can be managed by providing a good conceptual model and establishing standards.
Complexity is only acceptable in products when no conceptual model is needed.
Complexity should be left to the users to figure out on their own.
questions.correct_answer: Complexity can be managed by providing a good conceptual model and establishing standards.
